title: Dependency Scanning (SCA)
brief: **Ticket:** our dependencies may carry known CVEs. Scan them and name the critical package.
theory:
## SCA
Software Composition Analysis inventories dependencies and flags known-vulnerable (CVE) and unpinned ones. Tools: Trivy, Grype, OWASP Dependency-Check, pip-audit. Reads from an SBOM.

knowledge_check.q: SCA scans your ___ for known CVEs
A machine-readable inventory of components is an ___

investigation.intro: Run the SBOM analyzer and read the flagged components.
steps: It lists vulnerable components; one is marked CRITICAL.
hints: Look for the CRITICAL severity line.

capture.task: **Name the critical package.** Which component does the scan flag as CRITICAL? (one word)
capture.hint: A YAML parser with a code-exec CVE.
